title: SREV-059 GUI raw input size boundary contract

wire_data_length.description: Byte length sent through the GUI proxy request

service_reply_capacity.description: Maximum data bytes available after the raw-input reply header

contracts: GetRawInputDeviceInfo pData is optional but pcbSize is required
RIDI_DEVICENAME pcbSize is a character count rather than a byte count
The DLL hook must reject null pcbSize before sending a GUI proxy request
The DLL hook must reject Unicode character-to-byte overflow before request allocation
The GUI service must gate RIDI_DEVICENAME Unicode character count against max_data divided by sizeof(WCHAR) before multiplying
